title: NFTokenBurn
key_points: NFTokenBurn is a transaction type in the XRP Ledger.
It allows an NFToken issuer to burn (destroy) an NFToken from their account, removing it from circulation.
The transaction requires the burner account to have sufficient NFToken balances and enough XRP to cover fees.
When an NFToken is burned, its token ID becomes invalid, and any associated metadata is removed.
limitations: This documentation does not cover specific implementation details or best practices for using NFTokenBurn transactions.
asserts: The NFTokenBurn transaction enables the destruction of NFTokens from an issuer's account in the XRP Ledger.
